summary: A lookout has stood on Lyons Peak since 1913; the present 1964 cab is closed to the public by private land and litigation, and a 2021 shutter project was suspended.

facts.design: 13x13-ft CL-30 series steel cab on a 41-ft L-1600 series K-brace tower (chapter); NHLR gives a CL-160 cab

access.note: Tower surrounded by private land; access severely limited by litigation; helicopter or law enforcement escort only; base no longer open to the public.

visit.trail_note: No public route to the tower. The chapter says access is by helicopter or law enforcement escort only.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Cleveland National Forest

events.note: First lookout: a narrow 5x5-ft ground cabin on the rock (NHLR); the chapter says the peak has hosted a lookout tower since 1913.
Present cab with catwalk constructed in 1964 (NHLR).
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, December 16, 2008.
Volunteers airlifted in by sheriff helicopter fixed plywood shutters over the windows to protect the cab; the project is marked suspended.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR describes a CL-160 metal live-in cab; the chapter describes a 13x13-ft CL-30 steel cab on a 41-ft K-brace tower and calls it the only CL-30/41-ft combination in California. Recorded as CL-30 to match the brief and the chapter; NHLR may be wrong.
NHLR gives 3,741 ft (1,140 m); the chapter gives 3,642 ft (1,110 m). The brief's 1140.3 m is kept and the difference is flagged here.

notes_for_editor: Brief's 2018 events (a $300 FFLA stabilization grant and emergency stabilization materials) are not in events: the cited 2018 chapter report URL returned HTTP 404 and no other source read covers them. Brief's 2021 'restored' is corrected to 'modified' because the chapter describes protective plywood shutters and a suspended project. Brief says access is limited by right-of-way litigation; the sources read say only 'litigation' and do not mention right-of-way, so the record wording was not kept. Cab model conflict (CL-160 vs CL-30) is unresolved at source level; CL-30 is recorded. No source read is dated after 2021 for staffing, so 'unstaffed as of 2021' is the latest supported status. Weebly page (californialookouts.weebly.com/lyons-peak.html) not used beyond its header.
